alpine.label: Alpine Linux 3.24
alpine.description: Lightweight Linux distribution prepared for an interactive serial console on ttyS0. The root and toto accounts are available; the RAW image is read-only and each VM uses its own working disk.
alpine.login: root with no password; toto / toto

debian13-cloud.label: Debian 13 Cloud
debian13-cloud.description: Debian 13 prepared offline from the official cloud image. It boots from disk with GRUB, displays boot output and login on ttyS0, and provides root, toto and demo accounts.
debian13-cloud.login: root with no password; toto / toto; demo / serial-demo

debian13-legacy.label: Debian 13 Legacy (IDE + e1000)
debian13-legacy.description: Debian 13 prepared for legacy QEMU hardware: IDE system disk, e1000 Ethernet, and boot/login consoles on tty0 and ttyS0.
debian13-legacy.login: root with no password; toto / toto; demo / serial-demo

openwrt.label: OpenWrt 25.12 x86-64
openwrt.description: Lightweight network-oriented Linux system running in text mode on the serial console. A VDE network adapter can be selected before launch; its RAW base comes from the official disk image.
openwrt.login: Press Enter, then root with no password
